title: Eighth Pylon
summary: Hatshepsut’s gateway survives with extensive later changes to its decoration.
orientation: South of the Seventh Pylon and north of the Ninth.

claims.text: Hatshepsut’s gateway survives with extensive later changes to its decoration.
Thutmose III, Amenhotep II, Tutankhamun and Sety I intervened in the decoration. A visible royal name need not date the whole structure.
The north face includes a sacred-bark procession; identifying it specifically as Opet is qualified in the source.

caveats: Field access and demonstration viewpoints are unverified; this is an editorial research draft.
